text:
lina: Quick run: steering wants a go/no-go on MVP scope by EOD. Options: A) ship MVP with hosted API + embeddings + basic auth (email 2FA) and postpone tenant routing & full SSO; B) include tenant routing but delay embedding-cache + quantization. Need a clear pick.

omar: Leaning A. Tenant routing is large infra risk, likely adds ~3w timeline.

rebecca: Sales note: two strategic customers (AcmeCo, BetaMetrics) expected tenant routing. Can we offer a limited alpha instead of full delivery?

lina: Alpha could be OK if we set expectations and guardrails. Cost impact from skipping embedding-cache is real though.

tom: Engineering: embedding-cache is higher ROI on cost and latency. But we can scope the cache to hosted-only (no per-tenant plumbing) to reduce complexity. That yields ~2w savings versus full routing.

rebecca: Proposal: Choose A for MVP (hosted + embedding-cache scoped + email 2FA) + gated tenant alpha for top-2 customers. v1 = full tenant routing + SSO + SMS/TOTP. Agree? :thinking_face:

omar: Agree with gated alpha if we require customer signoff and a short SLA caveat. Also want explicit rollout guardrails (canary windows, kill-switch, perf SLOs).

pm-bot: Milestone updated: https://redwood/issue/PROD-789. Field changes: mvp_scope="A + tenant-alpha", v1_scope="routing,sso,sms-totp".

Tom: I'll own rollout guardrails + rollback checklist. Draft items:
```
- canary_window_minutes: 60
- watch: latency_p95, error_rate_5xx, embedding_hit_rate
- kill_switch: feature-flag -> off
- customer_opt_in_list maintained in docs
```

lina: Rebecca please prep customer comms template for the alpha opt-in, highlight known limitations and SLA notes.

rebecca: On it. Draft by 11:30 and post in the ticket.

omar: Timeline ask: increase infra buffer from 2w to 4w and mark contingency on the milestone. Lina approve?

lina: Approve. Update milestone tracker and call out contingency.

deploy-bot: Canary env provisioned: canary-mvp-1755. URL: https://canary.redwood/internal/canary-mvp-1755 :rocket:

rebecca: One more business check: which beta customers get alpha? I'll coordinate with sales after the comms template.

lina: Locking scope to 'A + tenant alpha' unless objections by EOD. :lock:

rebecca: No objections. :white_check_mark:

tom: No objections. Starting guardrail doc now.

omar: No objections.

lina: Thanks team. I'll post the milestone note and tag leadership after EOD if nothing changes. :raised_hands:
